title: The Cauchy-Schwarz inequality $|\sum_i a_i b_i|^2 \leq (\sum_i a_i^2)(\sum_i ...

problemStatement.formal: For finite families a_1,...,a_n and b_1,...,b_n in a linearly ordered field, (\sum_i a_i b_i)^2 \le (\sum_i a_i^2)(\sum_i b_i^2), with sum-of-squares certificate (Lagrange identity) (\sum_i a_i^2)(\sum_i b_i^2) - (\sum_i a_i b_i)^2 = (1/2)\sum_{i,j}(a_i b_j - a_j b_i)^2 \ge 0.
problemStatement.plain: AVAILABLE — The Cauchy-Schwarz inequality $|\sum_i a_i b_i|^2 \leq (\sum_i a_i^2)(\sum_i b_i^2)$ also follows from a sum-of-squares argument.
